report:
Findings:  Small knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  10 mm x 6 mm by 16mm well-defined lobulated intramedullary lesion in the distal metadiaphysis of the right femur display low signal on T1 and high signal on PD sequences. Multiple hypointense foci within the lesion representing calcification. No perilesional edema, endosteal scalloping or cortical destruction. Findings are in keeping with a low-grade chondroid lesion (enchondroma).  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact lateral meniscus. Radial tearing of the inner free of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.  Normal appearance of the distal biceps femoris tendon, popliteus tendon, pes anserine tendons and distal iliotibial band.  Intact quadriceps and patellar tendons. Severe patellofemoral degenerative changes with high-grade chondral thinning and full-thickness chondral loss along the lateral retropatellar facet and corresponding lateral femoral trochlea surface with underlying stress changes. The patella is lateralized relative to the femoral trochlear groove. Evidence of trochlear dysplasia with a shallow trochlear groove.  Relatively well-maintained medial and lateral tibiofemoral hyaline articular cartilage. Tricompartmental osteophyte formation noted.  
Conclusion:  Radial tearing of the inner free edge of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Severe patellofemoral degenerative changes with evidence of trochlear dysplasia and lateralization of the patella relative to the trochlear groove.

Na učinjenim MR presjecima kroz lijevo koljeno nalaze se izražene osteoartritičke promjene
femorotibijalnog i umjerene femoropatelarnog zgloba, izraženije u medijalnom kompartmentu.
Vidljive su zone denudacije hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i medijalnog platoa tibije. Manji
areali subhondralnog edema zglobnih tijela. Osteofitoza.
Hondromalacija drugog stupnja trohlearne hrskavice.
Uznapredovala mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta. U anteriornom dijelu
ligamenta promjene intenziteta signala koje mogu odgovarati kalcifikatima. Ne nalazi se jasnih
znakova rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je blaže degenerativno promijenjen, održanog kontinuiteta.
Stanje po kompleksnoj rupturi medijalnog meniska na bazi degenerativnih promjena, vidljiva je
ekstruzija tijela meniska van koštanog okvira zgloba. Ruptura zahvaća stražnji korijen meniska.
Uz interkondilarnu eminenciju nalazi se "flap" meniska.
Lateralni menisk umjereno degenerativno promijenjen, bez jasne rupture.
Vanjski sloj medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta održan. Promijenjen intenzitet signala
femoromeniscealnog i tibiomeniscealnog ligamenta, moguće stanje po rupturi.
Održan je kontinuitet lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta. Vidljive su umjerene degenerativne
promjene.
Uznapredovale tendinopatske promjene tetive muskulusa popliteusa uz formirane ganglion ciste
na femoralnom hvatištu i blaži burzitis tetive. Vidljiva je i ganglion cista na tetivno-mišićnom
prijelazu.
Nalaze se degenerativne promjene hvatišta medijalne i lateralne glave muskulusa
gastroknemijusa za femur uz brojne sitne ganglion ciste.
Održani iliotibijalni trakt. Primjeren prikaz tetiva pes anserinus. Održana tetiva bicepsa.
Entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa. Održan ligament patele.
Nalazi se Baker cista veličine 25 mm na aksijalnim presjecima. Minimalni izljev u koljenskom
zglobu.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Meniscopatía interna, condromalacia rotuliana.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar la superficie
articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura. Mínima extrusión meniscal.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial, sin significativos
cambios óseos secundarios. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales sin lesiones significativas. Fina úlcera
condral focal de espesor total de la vertiente medial de la tróclea femoral sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de distribución difusa de la rótula.
Leve aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Mínimo derrame articular. Distensión con líquido de receso posterolateral de la rodilla con probable filtración.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano y de la inserción distal del
tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendones de la pata de ganso, visible tibial dentro de tres
normales.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 3 de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. Úlcera condral focal grado
3 de la vertiente medial de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía rotuliana con lesiones grado 2.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular. No hay distensión con líquido receso posterolateral con probable filtración.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal

МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Няма данни за костномозъчен едем. Минимално количество ставен излив. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиален менискус – 3 степен. Последната е с кос ход и достига ставната повърхност на тибията. Лезия на късо протежение с вертикален ход се визуализира и в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2 степен. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. 
Визуализира се малка Бекерова киста с типична локализация и р-р 23/12мм. Наличие на малка ганглион киста до медиалната повърхност на главата на фибулата с р-р 27/6мм. Заключение:  МР данни за лезии в задните рога на медиалния менискус (3 степен) и латералния менискус (2 степен). Малка Бекерова киста. Ганглион киста с описаната локализация.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia bilateral.
Hallazgos:
Mínimo edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral lateral. No hay otras alteraciones en
significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones significativas.
Mínimo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Edema las partes blandas, profundo los tendones de la pata de ganso.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones.
Impresión:
Mínimo edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral lateral, inespecífico.
Mínimo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial y posteromedial de la rodilla

Diz eklemindeki hafif dereceli trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal patellofemoral kompartmanda daha belirgin ve eklem kıkırdaklarında kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan kıkırdak kaybı ve dejenerasyonu ve medyal kompartmanda milimetrik osteofitler ile karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı normal. Ön çapraz bağın tibyaya yapışma kesiminde tibyal platoda subkortikal kemik iliği ödemi gözleniyor (kontüzyon?). Ön çapraz bağdaki sinyal artışı parsiyel yırtığı telkin ediyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyale 4 mm ekstrüde medyal menisküsün arka kökünde parsiyel yırtık izleniyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal. Gastroknemyus-semimembranozis bursasındaki 7 cm uzunluklu ve en çok 8 mm kalınlıklı septalı sıvı lokülasyonu sızdırmıyor.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] female with right knee pain to the lateral joint line and infrapatellar pain after injury. Rule out meniscal tear.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. There is prepatellar edema which may correlate clinically with prepatellar bursitis.

 The Insall Salvati ratio measures about 1.4 consistent with mild patella alta. There is some attenuation of the medial patellar retinaculum with slight lateral subluxation of the patella. Findings may relate to remote injury related to transient lateral dislocation of the patella.

There is chondral fissuring and chondral loss seen to the patellar apex and lateral facet associated with subcortical cyst formation in the patella and with edema. The articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea demonstrates mild chondral fissuring seen at the trochlear apex but is otherwise reasonably well-maintained. The TT TG distance measures about 9 mm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The medial meniscus contains some mild non-surfacing signal in the posterior horn and body but demonstrates no surfacing meniscal tear.

The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a multiloculated ganglion cyst seen within the popliteal fossa posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament. This measures 2.9 cm in height, and 1.1 by 0.8 cm in short axis. It is situated anterior to the lateral fibers of the medial head of the gastrocnemius.

There is no significant Baker's cyst. There is no evidence of significant knee effusion.

Marrow signal is otherwise within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

Patella alta.

Severe chondromalacia patella. Associated attenuation of the medial patellar retinaculum, possibly related to remote transient lateral patellar dislocation.

Prepatellar bursitis.

Popliteal fossa ganglion cyst as described.

No evidence of internal derangement.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior horn ve gövde düzeyinde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi. Medial menisküs hafif ekstrude görünümdedir. Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkırdak  da medial ve lateral fasette bütünlük kaybı ve komşu kemikte subkondrial kemik iliiği ödemi ve milimetrik kistler izlendi ( tip IV kondromalazi ). Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Gastrocnemius medial krus bacağında sinyal artışı ve posterior superior komşuluğunda 17x6 mm boyutlarında lobüle konturlu ganglion kisti izlendi.

Zentrierte Stellung im rechten Kniegelenk. Kein Bone Bruise. Patella zentriert ohne Hochstand oder Tiefstand. Gering akzentuiert Gelenkflüssigkeit. Unauffälliger Knorpelbesatz retropatellar sowie femorotibial. Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes. Gering streifige Signalanhebungen im Außenmeniskushinterhorn (6/25) DD mukoide Degeneration. Des Weiteren gering streifige Signalanhebungen im Innenmeniskushinterhorn und Vorderhorn ohne Hinweis auf eine Rissbildung. Intakte Darstellung des medialen und lateralen Kollateralbandes. Unauffällige Signalgebung der miterfassten Weichteile. Intakte Darstellung der Quadrizepssehne und Patellasehne.
